title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FlexibilityInstruction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FlexibilityInstruction. The various types of instructions Flexibility Sources can send and/or receive.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FlexibilityInstruction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasCost.description: Relationship. Additional costs per second (e.g. wear, services) associated with this operation mode in the currency defined by the ResourceManagerDetails , excluding the commodity cost. The range is expressing uncertainty and is not linked to the operation_mode_factor. Relationship to DataPoint.

relatesToOffer.description: Relationship. The relationship between the s4ener:FlexibilityInstruction and the flexibility offer. Relationship to FlexOffer.

abnormalCondition.description: Property. Indicates if this is an instruction during an abnormal condition

hasExecutionTime.description: Property. Start time of the instruction

hasInstructionStatus.description: Property. Present status of this instruction. Controlled vocabulary (InstructionStatus).
